text_block_list.text:
At long last, I, the Overlord, have
entered the
Twinkle Series. The time for
my presence to shine
upon the masses
has come!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Thus, here I am with my nose to the
grindstone in
hopes of reaching its
twinkling summit. I shall
hone my skills
beyond perfection for a victorious

performance!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text: Now begins the prologue to Origins of the Centurial Overlord.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
